text:
The error-button proposal is clear, so I rewrote nothing. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags for its folder. I did not shoot any pages, since the folder has no `page.js` and this is a proposal.

The `requirements.md` title and ask say what the problem is: a stale dictate button on the "Page Load Error" screen. The steps are short and numbered. I appended one "clear" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I wrote the review to `error-button/review.md` with `verdict: fix`: six `[fix]` findings and two `[note]`s. I didn't run the smoke test, open the shots or exercise the 404 page.

- **Cause not logged:** the task folder has no `task.jsonl` or `log` lines, so requirement 2 (name the file, line and reason) is unmet. The cause appears only in a code comment in the diff.
- **Missing shots:** only the 390-wide before and after shots exist. There are none at 1200 and none for the second 404 url.
- **Desktop not covered:** the CSS rule applies only below 52em, so the ✦ button still shows on the error screen at 1200. Nothing in the folder says whether that case was checked.
- **Wrong button, maybe:** the diff hides the ✦ drawer button (`menu.js:25`), which the drawer readme calls the AI button. Nothing shows it is the "older dictate" the owner meant.
- **Readmes not updated:** `core/App` and `ext/drawer` don't mention `app-error` or the hidden button, though requirement 3 asks for that.
- **No branch, commit or smoke result:** none are recorded in the folder, so a fresh agent can't continue from it.

The two notes: `app-error` is never removed if the app recovers without a reload, and a simpler fix (hide the button when only the error page is mounted) might avoid the extra class in `App.js`.
